subject: maths
question: By selling at a loss of 12% instead of a loss of 18% an article sells for Rs. 120 more. Find its CP.
solution:
**Given:**

By selling at a loss of 12% instead of a loss of 18%, an article sells for Rs. 120 more.

**Concept:**

The difference in selling prices at different loss percentages can be used to find the cost price (CP) of the article.

**Formula Used:**

Let CP be the cost price.

Selling Price (SP) at 12% loss = CP × (1 - 12/100)

Selling Price (SP) at 18% loss = CP × (1 - 18/100)

Given that the difference in SP is Rs. 120.

**Calculation:**

We have,

⇒ CP × (1 - 12/100) - CP × (1 - 18/100) = 120

⇒ CP × (0.88) - CP × (0.82) = 120

⇒ CP × (0.88 - 0.82) = 120

⇒ CP × 0.06 = 120

⇒ CP = 120 / 0.06

⇒ CP = 2000

**∴ The cost price (CP) of the article is Rs. 2000.**
